mapper.select: SELECT cg.CORP_GR , cg.TR_YMD , cg.TR_CD , cg.FUND_CD , cg.JM_CD , cg.SEQ_NO , cg.TR_CO_CD , cg.AEKM , cg.DANGA , cg.DANGA * 10000 AS com_danga , cg.TR_AEK , cg.SUSU , cg.SODUK_TAX , cg.JUMIN_TAX , cg.IJA_TAX , cg.SUDO_YMD , cg.MK_SUIK_RT , cg.JAJUN_GB , cg.CHUI_AEK , mm.TR_CO_NM AS xx_tr_co_cd , cj.CJ_FNM AS xx_jm_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , cg.DANGA_GB , cg.JAJUN_SAYU , cg.MK_SUIK_RT * 100 AS com_mk_suik_rt , cm.BFIL_AEKM AS boyu_aekm , cg.BUY_DATE , cg.IJA_AEKM , cg.CRE_USER , 1 AS p_visible FROM SCT0CG cg LEFT JOIN SCM0CM cm ON cm.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND cm.YMD = cg.TR_YMD AND cm.FUND_CD = cg.FUND_CD AND cm.JM_CD = cg.JM_CD AND cm.BUY_DATE = cg.BUY_DATE LEFT JOIN SCM0CJ cj ON cj.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND cj.JM_CD = cg.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SZX2MM mm ON mm.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND mm.TR_CO_CD = cg.TR_CO_CD JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = cg.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = cg.FUND_CD WHERE cg.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND cg.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND cg.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY cg.FUND_CD, cg.JM_CD, cg.SEQ_NO
